files.text:
process TRIDENT_VALIDATE {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_single'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine == 'singularity' && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/poseidon-trident:2.2.2.1--hf7d7819_0'
        : 'quay.io/biocontainers/poseidon-trident:2.2.2.1--hf7d7819_0'}"

    input:
    // Inputs need to be synchronised so that all files for a given package are provided together.
    tuple val(meta), path(input_package)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path(input_package), env("EXIT_CODE"), emit: validated_packages
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('trident'), eval('trident --version'), emit: versions_trident, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    """
    trident validate \
        -d . \
        ${args} || EXIT_CODE=\$?

    EXIT_CODE=\${EXIT_CODE:-0}
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    """
    EXIT_CODE=0
    echo trident validate -d . ${args}
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/trident/validate"
description: "Check Poseidon packages or package components for structural correctness"
keywords:
- "poseidon-trident"
- "poseidon"
- "trident"
- "validate"
tools:
- trident:
    description: "A tool (trident) to work with modular genotype databases formatted\
      \ using Poseidon."
    homepage: "https://www.poseidon-adna.org/"
    documentation: "https://www.poseidon-adna.org/#/trident?id=validate-command"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/poseidon-framework/poseidon-hs/"
    doi: "10.7554/eLife.98317.1"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test', version:\
        \ \"2.1.0\", snpSet: \"1240K\", format:'EIGENSTRAT' ]\n"
  - input_package:
      type: "directory"
      description: "Path to the directory containing the Poseidon package(s) to be\
        \ validated."
output:
  validated_packages:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "The meta information of the input package."
    - input_package:
        type: "directory"
        description: "Path to the directory containing the Poseidon package(s) that\
          \ was validated."
    - EXIT_CODE:
        type: "string"
        description: "Exit code (0 for success, non-zero otherwise) that is the result\
          \ of the validation check."
        ontologies: []
  versions_trident:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - trident:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - trident --version:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - trident:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - trident --version:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@TCLamnidis"
maintainers:
- "@TCLamnidis"
version: "0.0.0-b6403fd"
license: "MIT License"
